doc.title: Richard Wyands interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 7, 2002

title: Personnel on Etta Jones session
summary: Roy Haynes, George Duvivier, Skeeter Best and Frank Wess; Duvivier organized the date.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Do you recall who also was in the rhythm section?

Oh yeah. Roy Haynes, George Duvivier, Skeeter Best on guitar and Frank Wess on tenor and flute on that record. George was very good, George Duvivier. He really organized it good for that date. It really came off very good. He just said okay, this is how we’re going to do it, and blah, blah, blah. And I’d make up some intros, we all made our little contributions and before you knew it five hours was up, or six.
